name: Hide & Seek Black Bourbon
ingredients: SUGAR*, REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), REFINED PALM OIL, COCOA SOLIDS (7.5%), INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, IODISED SALT, RAISING AGENTS [503 (ii), 500 (ii)) AND EMULSIFIER OF VEGETABLE ORIGIN I SOY LECITHIN ]. CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURAL COLOUR [ 150d) AND ADDED FLAVOURS (ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES-CHOCOLATE, VANILLA). *INCLUDING 2% AS SPRINKLED SUGAR CONTAINS:WHEAT AND SOY
